name: private-studio
description: Private Studio — orquestrador de monorepo (backend NestJS serve o frontend Vite) para deploy single-service no Railway.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix backend run migrate:deploy && node backend/dist/main.js
